items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 11 at 1:11AM EST until November 13 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
4 to 6 ft expected.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Oregon Inlet to Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Thursday to 10 AM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
